question: If 80 litres of milk solution has 60% milk in it, then how much milk should be added to make milk 80% in the solution?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Water percentage (Initial : Final) = 40% : 20% = 2 : 1

Total volume ratio (inverse of concentration) = 1 : 2

Original volume (1 unit) = 80 litres

Volume to be added = (2 − 1) = 1 unit

Added milk = 1 × 80 = 80 litres

**∴ The correct answer is 80 litres.**

Given: Initial volume = 80 litres, Milk (Initial) = 60%, Milk (Final) = 80%
